title: The Voidreaver

passive.name: Unseen Threat

description.normalized: Enhances next attack against enemy champions to deal an additional15 + 8 per level (+50% AD) magic damage and slow by 25% for 2 seconds. Unseen Threat is refreshed when the enemy team loses sight of Kha'Zix.

q.name: Taste Their Fear

description.normalized: Slashes with his claws, dealing 75 / 110 / 145 / 180 (+130% AD) physical damage. If the target is isolated, the damage is increased by 110%. Evolved Reaper Claws: Attacks and Taste Their Fear gain 50 range and 40% Taste Their Fear's cooldown is refunded against isolated targets. Units without allied units or structures nearby are isolated.

w.name: Void Spike
